slice: A7 process wiring slice 2: recovery retention tick in the Slack relay
author: Claude Code (Opus 5.5)
flow: relay loop: after the existing Slack request/task prune (60s), run RecoveryRetention.tick every 600s
feature on: RecoveryApprovalService.retention -> approval ledger prune (tombstone identity/approver/proof hashes) + outbox prune
feature off: OrphanOutboxRetention -> only outbox rows left by an earlier enabled run; never creates the table or reads a policy
recovery_outbox.prune_existing: delete under the existing processing lock only if the table exists; RecoveryOutbox.prune delegates (same behaviour)
not while stopping; failures are swallowed and retried next interval; no retention object -> unchanged loop calls

strengthened_tests: enabled relay uses its own ledger/outbox
stop during request prune skips retention
relay entrypoint passes the retention object

test_note: an existing relay-loop test counts stopped.is_set() calls; the extra stop check runs only when a retention object is present
known_behaviour: approval ledger is not pruned while the feature is off (needs the policy hash); records are hashes and times, pruned once re-enabled
restart evidence and sealed capture directories are added when the restart path is wired (path/PVC decision)
processing-lock contention records an 'outbox' failure and retries next interval
retention period stays the 7-day policy minimum
no_external_actions: no cluster, GitHub write besides this PR, deploy, Slack, incident drill, Terraform, paid model call
